## Where This Lives in UpstreamDrift {#sec-upstream-implementation-gom-vol0-ch12}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The regression demo in this chapter is an AffineDrift teaching stub (`src/tools/learning_examples.py`). When a swing or humanoid study moves from exposition to numerical optimization inside UpstreamDrift, start from the pinned trajectory-optimization stack at commit [`27b6eead`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/commit/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da).

- **Scipy swing optimizer:** [`swing_optimizer.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/shared/python/optimization/swing_optimizer.py) — multi-objective waypoint optimization on the shared closed-form swing model (`scipy.optimize` path).
- **CasADi transcription backend:** [`casadi_backend.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/shared/python/optimization/casadi_backend.py) — direct transcription with symbolic RNEA dynamics and an IPOPT solve when the optional `casadi` extra is installed.

**Convention note:** AffineDrift illustrates learning objectives in closed form; production UpstreamDrift runs still require explicit model assets, constraint sets and solver configuration before any policy-gradient or trajectory result is interpreted as validated.
:::
